title: The waiter guard allows the Monitor call its own remedy names
why: Possible false alarm (lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm, via coordinator 11:25 CST Nov 8): the waiter guard refused a Monitor call that its own remedy recommends. Reproduce first; step waiter-wait-until (ready) touches the same remedy.
note: Reproduced (lane, 11:23 CST Nov 8): a Monitor until-loop that tests for a folder with a 2 s pause is refused by the waiter rule, though its remedy says "use the Monitor tool once" and the harness says to use Monitor with an until-loop. Second sighting (triage, 11:24 CST): the waiter rule refused a python heredoc whose string data quoted that loop, so it also reads quoted text as an act (rule building-scanner-respects-strings).
